svg.aria-label: Tesamorelin compared with a 29-residue GHRH analog. 44 amino acids plus an N-terminal hexenoyl cap; about 5,136 Da
svg.text: Tesamorelin compared with a 29-residue GHRH analog
44 amino acids plus an N-terminal hexenoyl cap; about 5,136 Da
Tesamorelin: GHRH 1-44 with trans-3-hexenoyl cap (about 5,136 Da)
Full-length chain; harder to synthesize cleanly, so the chromatogram matters
Shorter analog built on the first 29 residues of GHRH
Unmodified GHRH(1-44) is about 5,040 Da; the cap adds roughly 96 Da.
